name: courier-card
title: Courier card
description: The delivery driver at a glance: photo or initial, first name, vehicle and plate, rating and arrival time, with Call and Message buttons and a same-size waiting state.
docs: Pass the courier (a first name, and optionally photo, vehicle, plate, rating) and eta in minutes; send a new eta whenever your tracking has one. The card shows only the first word of the name and never draws a phone number: onCall and onMessage are buttons you handle, or callHref and messageHref make them links, in which case use a relay or masked number, since the href is in the page. Both are named for the courier ("Call Mehmet"). The visible arrival time follows every update; the spoken one waits for it to settle and only speaks when the state changes, the time moved by two minutes or more, or the courier is about to arrive. Without a courier (or with status="pending") the card keeps its size and says "Looking for a courier"; the buttons are there but disabled. status="arrived" ends the countdown. eta.ts holds firstName and the rule for what is worth saying, and runs on the server too.
